topic: Campaign metrics and project status updates
summary_markdown: The conversation covered past requests for AI optimization insights, including optimizing campaigns based on impressions, calculating reach/impressions for specific demographics (women 20-30 in São Paulo), and comparing historical data (Rio last two weeks vs. 12 months prior). Regarding current projects, a meeting was held with the data team, which included someone named Galina. The outcome of this meeting was that some metrics need fixing, while others require explanation to the client. A follow-up session is scheduled for Monday. Two high-priority tasks were mentioned: DOOH-1734 and DOOH-1919. However, one task (DOOH-1919) was advised by someone named Marina to be postponed indefinitely.
decisions: A follow-up meeting regarding campaign metrics is scheduled for Monday.
